# Where MirrorImaged differs from the game's lines in expected/numbers-functions.txt, in order, with why (decisions D121): a line
# starting - is the game's, + MirrorImaged's, and ! says MirrorImaged's run stopped without lines. A note starts "# ".
# asin and acos from 0 to 1 less 2^-13 (acos 2^-10) are the table of D712 (Close); beyond that, the double model's (D32, D152, D484).
# atan is the double model's, a float step or two off; the game's is x (1 - 2^-20) near 0 (D32, D152, Close; D484,
# not fitted).
# atan(y, x) off the axes is the double model's (D32, D152, Close).
# log is the double model's (D32, D152, Close; D484, D711, not fitted): the game's is right near 1 and off from 1.5 up
# (log(1000) by 41 float steps).
# A power that isn't whole is exp(y log x), so off as log is (D32, D152, D484, Close); whole powers match.
